faq.title: Questions about this Gemini watermark remover
faq.q1: Can I remove the Gemini watermark online without uploading my image?
faq.a1: Yes. This gemini watermark remover runs locally in your browser. The image stays on-device, so you can remove the visible Gemini watermark online without sending the file to a remote processing server.
faq.q2: Does this gemini logo remover work on every image?
faq.a2: No. It is designed for supported Gemini-generated images that contain the visible lower-right watermark pattern. If detection is not confident, the tool will skip removal instead of making destructive edits.
faq.q3: What is the difference between remove Gemini watermark and hidden watermark removal?
faq.a3: This site focuses on the visible Gemini watermark only. It does not remove hidden watermarking systems such as SynthID and should not be described as a universal hidden-watermark remover.
faq.a4: Yes. You can drag multiple images into the uploader, let the queue process them locally, and then download the results together as a ZIP file.
